title: Model Binding & Validation
description: Master model binding and validation techniques in ASP.NET Core from beginner to advanced.
longDescription: This module covers model binding from basic to advanced concepts, including how data is transferred between views and controllers. You will also learn about model validation to ensure data integrity and provide user-friendly error messages.
whatYouLearn: Understand how model binding works in ASP.NET Core
Bind complex objects and collections from forms
Use custom model binders for advanced scenarios
